Title: Mystery Snails — 3 Pack (Assorted Colors)
Body (HTML):
A surprise 3-pack of mystery snails — colors selected randomly from current stock and may include gold, blue, ivory, purple, black, magenta, or wild-type brown. Perfect for adding a pop of color and natural algae control to your tank.

About Mystery Snails: Peaceful, hardy algae grazers that won't harm plants or fry. They breathe air via a siphon so they need a tight-fitting lid and about 1 inch of headspace above the waterline. Keep in pH 7.0–8.4 with calcium-rich water (or a cuttlebone) to support strong shell growth.

Tankmate compatibility: Community fish, shrimp, and other peaceful tankmates. Avoid pufferfish, loaches, and aggressive cichlids.

Shipping: Live arrival guarantee on overnight shipping. Snails ship in insulated containers with breathable lids. Acclimate to your tank water for 15–30 minutes before release.

  • Scientific name: Pomacea bridgesii
  • Size at shipping: Juvenile, approximately 1/2 to 1 inch shell diameter
  • Adult size: 1.5–2 inches
  • Lifespan: 1–2 years
  • Diet: Algae, biofilm, blanched vegetables, sinking pellets, calcium supplements
  • Temperature: 68–82°F
  • Water type: Freshwater
